subject: Future Tech
title: Entanglement Revealed
description: A quick, practical guide to Entanglement Revealed.

hook.text: Entangle two qubits and they become linked. Measure one as 0, and the other instantly becomes 1.

buildup.text: Einstein called this 'spooky action at a distance.' He believed it proved quantum theory was incomplete.

discovery.text: In 1964, John Bell designed a test. Experiments later confirmed entanglement is real, not a hidden trick.

twist.text: Entanglement can't send information faster than light. It creates correlations that algorithms can exploit.

climax.text: Quantum computers use entangled qubits to coordinate calculations no classical machine can replicate.

punchline.text: Entangled qubits share a fate, not a message.

quiz.question: Who called entanglement 'spooky action at a distance'?
